why: The one line that carries which slots a computer drives from the setup pane into the simulation. Dropping it leaves every unit test of the commitment itself passing -- those build their own worlds and stamp `botDifficulty` directly -- while every real versus session silently reverts to the pre-#891 bot: no commitment, no contact overlay, nearest-target-every-tick. A feature that works only in its own tests is the failure mode this pins.
killedBy: createVersusLevelSystem bot difficulty reaches every bot slot's tank -- fails if `bots` is dropped before createWorldFor
